run_structure_generator_cli: run the structure generator CLI to create adsorbate slab placements with vasp input files
run_precompute_slabs: run the precompute slabs function to generate and save slab surfaces for bulk indices
run_parse_args: run the parse args function to validate command line arguments for structure generation
run_run_placements: run the placements function to generate adsorbate on slab configurations via multiprocessing
run_structure_generator_class: run the StructureGenerator class to create adsorbate bulk slab objects and write vasp files
